components.name: CareAgents
components.description: A patient's health assistant that answers a clinic's check-in request from their records, with per-item consent. Answers are encrypted in the browser and not stored by CareAgents.
components.notes: Sign in on the wallet page with an emailed code. Answers come from a synthetic US Core test patient (no real data). Self-serve access to the test patient lands by Oct 27; until then, post in #kill-the-clipboard and mention CareAgents and we will set you up. Supports the three minimum scenarios: share records and insurance (US Core, C4DIC Coverage), PHQ-2 inline, decline an item. Records without a US Core profile claim are answered unavailable. Responses are capped at about 400 KB, so the large-response scenario is not supported yet. Testing guide: https://healthclaw.io/static/connectathon/careagents-wallet.html
